lead: Ranjan Gogoi is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 18 November 1954 in Dibrugarh.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has held the office of Chief Justice of India and member of parliament.
This profile collects the Ranjan facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Ranjan Gogoi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ranjan Gogoi was born on 18 November 1954 in Dibrugarh, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Keshab Chandra Gogoi and his mother, Shanti Gogoi. He is a sibling of Anjan Gogoi, Nirjan Gogoi, Indira Gogoi and Nandita Hazarika.
He received his education at Faculty of Law, St. Stephen's College and Cotton University.

sections.heading: Ranjan Gogoi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.
He has held the following offices: Chief Justice of India (2018–2019) and member of parliament (2020–present).

sections.heading: Ranjan Gogoi — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Rupanjali Gogoi.
He is a parent to Raktim Gogoi and Rashmi Gogoi.
